sources.entry: Widelands - Widelands is a free, open source real-time strategy game with singleplayer campaigns and a multiplayer mode. The game was inspired by Settlers II™ (© Bluebyte) but has significantly more variety and depth to it.

summary.one_liner: Widelands is a free, open source real-time strategy game with singleplayer campaigns and multiplayer, inspired by Settlers II.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Widelands as a free, open source real-time strategy game with singleplayer campaigns and a multiplayer mode, inspired by Settlers II but with more variety and depth. It is licensed under GPL v2+, with some assets under various Creative Commons licenses. The README covers building from source on Linux, Windows (MSys2 and MSVC) and MacOS, using either a convenience script (compile.sh) or CMake, with optional Ninja support. It lists many CMake options for build type, sanitizers, tests, XDG paths and GL library choice. It also points to contributor documentation for scenarios, art, translations, testing and issue triage, and states an AI-generated content policy.
use_cases: playing a free strategy game with campaigns
playing multiplayer real-time strategy online or on a LAN
contributing scenarios, art or translations to an open source game
how_to_run: mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && make
notable: Inspired by Settlers II but aims for more variety and depth
Cross-platform builds for Linux, Windows and MacOS
Convenience compile script and full CMake option set, including AddressSanitizer and codecheck targets
caveats: Requires building from source with several dependencies (SDL 2 family, Asio, GL library) unless a prebuilt download is used; the README's download section is empty in this copy
Pull requests generated largely by AI may be closed under the project's policy
Some assets fall under separate Creative Commons licenses
